params.prompt: Create one continuous 15-second cinematic shot from the start image @Image1, square 1:1, one single take with no cuts. Photoreal, natural realistic colours, warm evening practical light. Start exactly on @Image1: a young woman dentist in a white coat has just placed a small white architectural model of her dental clinic on the dark wooden table; the man with platinum-white hair and a beard, in a white t-shirt and an open charcoal overshirt, leans on the table and looks at the model with calm interest, then gives a small confident nod as if he already knows how to solve it. 0-4 seconds: the camera slowly and smoothly glides forward and down towards the model, as if shrinking to its scale, the office softly blurs away. 4-15 seconds: at miniature scale, one continuous gentle glide along the tiny night street in front of the clinic, real tilt-shift macro look: tiny hooded agent figures with small head lamps switch things on one after another — first the clinic's big shop window lights up like a website display, then a street light-box poster with a smiling patient, then a billboard on the roof, then a desk phone at the reception glows and rings, finally the door opens, a tiny concierge greets people, tiny patients walk in and queue, a small cash register glows warmly. Smooth, continuous, calm pace; consistent people and model; no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
